_comment: Reinhard's second quest: his wedding ring is lost on Saltgrass Strand, the beach north of the Farmlands. Offered and turned in by Reinhard (miller.json). ⭐ THE FIRST CHANCE OBJECTIVE: the search stage is a FIND — every Seaweed heap harvested while it runs rolls a 6 % chance of turning up the ring (`chance`), and the 12th since stage entry always does (`guaranteedAt`, hidden: the tracker never shows a count). A hit advances the stage at once, so nothing beyond the stage path is persisted. ⚑ The beach is the SPECIES, not a region: Seaweed is placed only on the Strand (seaweed.json). Reward 216 XP on the turn-in row = the L9 half-level rule at the zone's level-3 band, 0.5 x 300 x 1.2^2. All values [PLACEHOLDER]; text plain (PO 2026-08-02).
title: Lost and Found

stages.journal: Find miller Reinhard's lost wedding ring on the beach north of the farm. It must be tangled in the seaweed washed up along the shore.
stages.tracker: Search the seaweed on the beach for the ring

stages.journal: The ring was tangled in a heap of seaweed. Reinhard will want it back before his wife notices.
